description: Sentry alert rules for Albora critical routes

rules.name: Media presign: rate > 5 errors/min
rules.notes: Presign endpoint (media upload initialization) is critical path to first photo upload. Rate > 5/min indicates systemic issue with R2 signing or validation.

rules.name: Wall display: any error
rules.notes: Wall (telão) display is live during event. Any error means guests see blank screen or missing photos.

rules.name: Billing: any error
rules.notes: Billing operations must not fail silently. Errors indicate payment processing or webhook handling issues.

rules.name: Operations/maintenance: any error
rules.notes: Ops endpoint (retention jobs, support tasks, etc.) must not fail silently. Data loss or orphaned records possible.

sentry_cli_usage: This file documents the alert rules that need to be configured in Sentry. To apply these rules programmatically, use the script apply-alerts.sh with a valid SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN. Until credentials are available, rules should be configured via Sentry UI at: https://sentry.io/settings/<org-slug>/projects/<project-slug>/alerts/
